verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs say it offers OpenFeature Providers and list OpenFeature compatibility, and its GitHub README says the OpenFeature partnership means users are "never locked into one vendor." That directly meets the story's goal of keeping flag code off a single vendor's SDK API. missing for 10: the actual list of supported provider languages (the quoted sentence is cut off before the list), provider feature-parity and depth documentation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of using Flagsmith through OpenFeature.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API

citations.quote: We currently offer [OpenFeature Providers](https://docs.openfeature.dev/docs/reference/concepts/provider) for the following languages:
OpenFeature Compatibility: Use Flagsmith with OpenFeature
Thanks to our partnership with OpenFeature, you are never locked into one vendor.
